tier1.headline: Your data is shared broadly.
tier1.quote: We may share limited categories of personal data (online identifiers and product-related information used to display appropriate ads) with these third parties for cross-contextual advertising purposes, as defined under California and other applicable U.S. state laws.

tier1.headline: Your data trains their AI.
tier1.quote: To maintain and develop threat intelligence resources, in particular to be able to detect and block malware. We analyze samples of files and URLs we detect on your devices or websites you visit, and we use them to maintain our malware and privacy protection at the highest level possible.

tier1.headline: Your data collected without account.
tier1.quote: For free versions, this disconnection or removal of identifiers begins when the products and services are initially activated.

tier2.headline: Your data shared internally.
tier2.quote: We only disclose your Personal Data as described below, within our group of companies, with our partners, with service providers that process data on our behalf and with public authorities, when required by applicable law.

tier2.headline: Your product data retained for years.
tier2.quote: The rolling deletion periods for Product Data are not longer than six years.

tier2.headline: Your location is collected.
tier2.quote: Device Data includes information about the operating system; hardware; city/country location of device; IP address, device error logs; browser; network; applications running on the device, including the Avast products; and Service Data includes information about product usage and events relating to use of our product by you.

tier2.headline: Your behavior is profiled.
tier2.quote: We use relevant Billing Data, Account Data, Product Data and your answers from surveys, in which you can participate, to personalize our offers, communication and product recommendations.

tier2.headline: Your data used for ads.
tier2.quote: To enable the ad, we embed a software development kit (“SDK”) provided by an advertising company into the product. The SDK collects Personal Data in order to personalize ads for you.

tier2.headline: Your data moves globally.
tier2.quote: The servers that are part of this infrastructure may therefore be located in a country different than the one where you live.

tier2.headline: Your data shared without warrant.
tier2.quote: No Personal Data will be disclosed to any public authority except in response to: [...] A request for data with the purpose of identifying and/or preventing credit card fraud.

tier2.headline: Your deletion rights are limited.
tier2.quote: You have the right to erasure of your Personal Data, but only in specific cases stipulated by law, e.g., if there is no legally recognized title on our part for further processing of your Personal Data (incl. protection of our legitimate interests and rights).
